```{r}
#| label: fig-age-mixing-matrix
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-cap: Spatial mixing matrix by age. The spatial mixing ratio measures the extent to which members of one age subgroup share community districts with members of another relative to chance. Values greater than 1 indicate more mixing than expected, whereas values between 0 and 1 indicate less mixing than expected.


targets::tar_read(plotdata_age_mixing_matrix) |>
  plot_matrix_mixing() +
  scale_fill_mpxnyc_gradient("Spatial\nmixing\ncoefficient", labels = scales::label_percent(), breaks = c(-0.5, 0, 0.5, 1), limits = c(-0.5, 1)) +
  scale_color_mpxnyc_gradient() +
  ggplot2::scale_alpha_discrete(guide = "none") +
  theme_mpxnyc_mixing() 
```
